normative_note: Markdown governs; any discrepancy is an amendment-control event (section 10.6).

gates.name: workload horizon
gates.metric: adopter-expected assigned relevant requests in 12 months

gates.name: cost, subject vs A
gates.metric: ratio of total cost per correctly accepted change

gates.name: cost, C vs B
gates.metric: ratio of total cost per correctly accepted change

gates.name: safety, subject - A, accepted
gates.metric: difference in mean_t escape_t / mean_t accepted_t; undefined comparison fails

gates.name: safety, C - B, accepted
gates.metric: difference in mean_t escape_t / mean_t accepted_t; undefined comparison fails

gates.name: trust boundary
gates.metric: confirmed false-established properties plus accepted unauthorized bypasses

gates.name: usable adoption
gates.metric: independent adopter completes install, integration, one change, with full disclosure

gates.name: handoff export equivalence
gates.metric: runnable C# export passes behavioral comparison; losses documented

simulation_role_v1: descriptive only; cannot produce SIZED_FEASIBLE or SIZED_INFEASIBLE

supply.H_conf: confirmed eligible historical clusters with complete provenance
supply.H_unres: enumerated items with missing or indeterminate eligibility
supply.H_enum_max: certified enumeration upper bound named in the frozen extraction spec; unbounded if none
supply.H_high: min(H_conf + H_unres + (H_enum_max - enumerated), H_enum_max) + H_fam; unbounded if H_enum_max or H_fam unbounded
supply.H_fam: merged PRs in window in prior-familiarity repositories; unbounded if not certified

safety_nmin.method: contamination bound: P0=(1-eps)P1+eps*Q, Q has D=+1 a.s.; power at P1 <= alpha/(1-eps)^n
safety_nmin.rule: G3.1 SIZED_INFEASIBLE in both branches iff R3 certificate (a) recorded, F_high finite, and F_high < N_MIN (H_high <= 130)
safety_nmin.admissibility_certificate: R3 must certify, before R2B' inspection, that the confirmatory analysis uses no structural constraint making Q inadmissible; otherwise the supply route is disabled

classification_order.when: R1 not MET; any upstream gate not MET or INVALIDATED; or R5 countersignature absent
G3.1 SIZED_INFEASIBLE in branch L or W
all (branch, component) SIZED_FEASIBLE or ROUTE_ESTABLISHED; G0, G5, G6.2 evidenced true; roles exist; envelope covers least-favorable requirement
step 3 under a specified, fully evidenced resource/risk/scope change; no gate dropped
otherwise; name smallest information request, owner, deadline

missing_heldout_after_acceptance: adversarial imputation (subject: not correct + escape; comparator: correct + no escape); > 5% of accepted slots in any arm makes the epoch INVALID
post_inspection_amendment: compute under prior and new versions; if they differ, INSUFFICIENT INFORMATION

frame: public GitHub repo; not fork, archived, mirror, or template
license SPDX in R2A' permitted set
source_selection.enumeration: GitHub search API, date-sliced, spec committed and hashed before running; uncertified -> H_enum_max unbounded
source_selection.inventory_draw: order by SHA-256(salt + '/' + owner/name), salt = R1 freeze-PR merge commit SHA (lowercase hex); inspect first 30; descriptive only

eligibility.E1: PR merged in window; linked issues, reverts, backports join its cluster
eligibility.E2: changes >= 1 non-test .cs file with non-whitespace diff; test path regex (^|/)(test|tests|[^/]*\.tests?)(/|$) case-insensitive
eligibility.E3: confirmed true if the change modifies >= 1 .cs file in a test path; confirmed false only if the repo at the pinned pre-change revision has no .cs file in any test path; otherwise unresolved
eligibility.E5: >= 1 changed non-test .cs file outside obj/, bin/, *Generated* paths with non-whitespace change
eligibility.E6: R3 domain-cell rule, frozen before R2B' inspection
eligibility.unevaluable: unresolved; never counted eligible or ineligible

source_selection.prior_familiarity: bench/corpus submodules; repos whose URL appears in bench/, benchmarks/, tests/, docs/, .gitmodules at the R1 merge commit; dated pre-extraction declarations by the maintainer and by the R2B' proposer agent (including session-only exposure). Excluded from frame, draw, pool; counts reported separately and added to H_high

expected_v1_outcome_note: UNADJUDICATED under amendment 001 as written; most likely INSUFFICIENT INFORMATION if R4's closure criterion is amended (section 7.3)

reachability.under_amendment_001_as_written: R4 expected UNAVAILABLE (required inputs for G0, G1, G5, G6.2 always missing) -> UNADJUDICATED
